W_XP_RANGE: quest XP is about 57% of the budget. The shared pool is short: most pack quests that the Durotar and Mulgore bands did not finish are race-limited to one branch or sit in the other start zone. Adding those for the other race would close the gap, but each one adds duplicate errors on the other branch (see the report). Left at 57% pending a decision.
